title: OCR and document intelligence
subtitle: Turn images and documents into grounded, reviewable information.
goal: Read information from scanned and image-based documents
intro: Recognizing characters is only the first step toward using a document correctly.
terms: Where content appears on a page
case: Extract a total from a scanned invoice containing a discount table.
The result keeps both the amount and its source region.
Correct words in the wrong table row still produce the wrong total.
